title: failure case: duplicate friend_request hits the dedup ledger
description: The same signed envelope (same message_id) is delivered twice — at-least-once mailbox semantics. The first apply succeeds; the redelivery must be rejected by the seen-message ledger and record envelope.dedup_hit with the original trace_id.

source.note: synthetic reconstruction of an at-least-once redelivery; loosely modeled on the June 9 friending incident's mailbox semantics, but that incident (ea-claude-130) was an ORPHANED delivery — no redelivery/dedup_hit was observed — so this stays origin: synthetic, not synthetic-promoted

body.note: synthetic reproduction: redelivery of the same message_id
